title: Do Moral Judgment and Reasoning Capability of LLMs Change with Language? A Study using the Multilingual Defining Issues Test
reasoning: The paper focuses on evaluating and benchmarking the moral reasoning and judgment capabilities of Large Language Models (LLMs) across different languages using the Defining Issues Test (DIT), a tool based on Kohlberg's Cognitive Moral Development (CMD) theory. It specifically analyzes how models respond to ethical dilemmas and ranks moral considerations.
